name: Obed (son of Boaz and Ruth)
title: David's grandfather
summary: Obed was the son of Boaz and Ruth, and became the grandfather of King David. His birth represented God's blessing on Ruth's faithfulness and was a vital link in the lineage of the Messiah. Through Obed, the Moabite woman Ruth was incorporated into Israel's history and Jesus' family tree.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Obed
keyEvents.description: Obed was born as the son of Boaz and Ruth, bringing great joy to Naomi who received a redeemer for her family.

keyEvents.title: Naming by the Neighboring Women
keyEvents.description: The neighboring women named the child Obed, which means 'servant', and declared that a son had been born to Naomi.

keyEvents.title: Obed in David's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Obed is mentioned in the genealogy connecting Perez with David, showing his place in the royal line.

keyEvents.title: Obed in Jesus' Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Obed is mentioned in the Gospel of Matthew as part of Jesus' lineage through David.

keyEvents.title: Obed in Luke's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Luke includes Obed in Jesus' lineage that extends back to Adam.
